events.title: GCC/PPOW: Forest Restoration Workshop on the Todt Hill Blue Trail
events.description: We are teaming up with the Protectors of Pine Oak Woods for It's My Park Day.
events.details: Join other volunteers to cut and uproot alien Devil's Walking Stick and search out and cut woody, twining vines from the trees. After the work session, we'll return to the parking lot by way of the St. Francis Woodlands boardwalk. Protectors will supply tools, gloves, and refreshments. Register through Eventbrite at POPOW or GCC so we know how many volunteers to expect.

events.title: Jesse Owens Track & Field Youth Program
events.description: Join the Randall\u2019s Island Park Alliance and City Parks Foundation for the Jesse Owens Track and Field Youth Program!
events.details: Join the Randall’s Island Park Alliance and City Parks Foundation for the Jesse Owens Track and Field Youth Program! This free weekly program is available to youth ages 8-16 and enables participants to learn the fundamentals of the sport and stay active. Activities will focus on running techniques for sprints and relays and will introduce other track and field activities like long jump, hurdles, and long-distance running. Registration is required on LeagueApps with City Parks Foundation . For inquiries about accessibility, to request an accommodation or for event information, please email publicprograms@randallsisland.org.

Featuring new works by Corey Rogers, Chad Restum, Carey Campbell, Catherine Monnett and Christopher D. White, produced by Creative Women New York. Creative Women New York is a non-profit theatre arts and producing organization, powered by women, and inclusive of all. Please RSVP for the event here . This event takes place in the newly-renovated 102nd Street Field House . Enter the Park at 102nd Street and Riverside Drive, then descend to the promenade level. The stairs to the Field House are across the promenade at 102nd Street.
